# freecropimage.app — Full Site Content

## Homepage (https://freecropimage.app/)

freecropimage.app is a free online image cropper that lets you crop, rotate, and resize images directly in your browser with no upload, no login, and no watermarks. Your images never leave your device — all editing happens locally using your browser's Canvas technology.

### Features
- Free crop with draggable rectangle, 8 resize handles
- Aspect ratio lock: Free, 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, 5:4, 3:4, 2:3
- Social media presets: Instagram Post (1080×1080), Instagram Story (1080×1920), Facebook Cover (820×312), Twitter Header (1500×500), YouTube Thumbnail (1280×720), LinkedIn Banner (1584×396), Passport Photo (600×600), Wallpaper 1080p (1920×1080)
- Rotate 90° clockwise/counterclockwise
- Flip horizontal/vertical
- Rule-of-thirds grid overlay
- Zoom 50%–300% with scroll wheel support
- Output format: JPG, PNG, WebP
- Quality control: 50%–100% slider
- Full-resolution export (not screen resolution)
- Undo (Ctrl+Z), keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+S download, R reset, G grid, Escape)
- Dark mode (synced across freesuite.app tools)

### Technology
Pure HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript. Zero external libraries. Canvas API for all image processing. FileReader API for local file loading. No server uploads. No tracking. No cookies.

### Supported Input Formats
JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG (up to 50MB)

### Output Formats
JPG (adjustable quality 50–100%), PNG (lossless), WebP (adjustable quality 50–100%)

---

## Crop for Instagram (https://freecropimage.app/crop-for-instagram.html)

Guide to cropping images for all Instagram dimensions using freecropimage.app.

### Instagram Dimensions
- Post: 1080×1080 (1:1 square)
- Story/Reel: 1080×1920 (9:16 vertical)
- Profile Picture: 320×320 (1:1 circle crop by Instagram)
- Carousel: 1080×1080 or 1080×1350

### How to Crop
1. Open freecropimage.app
2. Drop your image or click to browse
3. Select Instagram preset (Post, Story)
4. Adjust crop position
5. Download at full resolution

### Tips
- Use JPG at 85–95% quality for best file size
- Square crops ensure consistent feed appearance
- Use rule-of-thirds grid for composition

---

## Crop for Facebook (https://freecropimage.app/crop-for-facebook.html)

Guide to cropping images for all Facebook dimensions.

### Facebook Dimensions
- Cover Photo: 820×312
- Profile Picture: 170×170
- Post Image: 1200×630
- Event Cover: 1920×1005
- Group Cover: 1640×856

### Tips
- Cover photo text-safe zone: keep text in center 60%
- Profile picture displays as circle, crop to square first
- Use JPG for photos, PNG for graphics with text

---

## Crop for YouTube (https://freecropimage.app/crop-for-youtube.html)

Guide to cropping YouTube thumbnails and channel art.

### YouTube Dimensions
- Thumbnail: 1280×720 (16:9)
- Channel Banner: 2560×1440
- Channel Icon: 800×800

### Thumbnail Tips
- High contrast colors for visibility at small sizes
- Include faces — thumbnails with faces get more clicks
- Large, readable text (if any)
- JPG at 85–95% quality, keep under 2MB
- WebP for smaller file size

---

## vs Canva (https://freecropimage.app/vs-canva.html)

Honest comparison between freecropimage.app and Canva.

### freecropimage.app Advantages
- No login required
- No upload to servers (100% private)
- Instant — no loading design editor
- Works offline
- Free without limits
- Faster for simple cropping tasks

### Canva Advantages
- Full design tool with templates
- Text, shapes, stock photos, elements
- Collaboration features
- Brand kits
- Far more powerful for design work

### Verdict
Use Canva for design. Use freecropimage.app for quick, private image cropping.

### Comparison Table
| Feature | freecropimage.app | Canva |
|---|---|---|
| Price | Free | Free + paid |
| Account Required | No | Yes |
| Upload to Server | Never | Yes |
| Cropping | Yes | Yes |
| Design Tools | No | Yes |
| Templates | No | Yes |
| Offline | Yes | No |
| Speed (for cropping) | Instant | Slower |
| Social Presets | 8+ | Custom sizes |
| Privacy | 100% local | Cloud-based |

## Crop Without Upload (https://freecropimage.app/crop-image-without-upload.html)

Why and how to crop images without uploading to any server.

### Why Uploading Is a Risk
- Servers store copies of your images
- Data breaches can expose personal photos
- Terms of service may allow third-party access
- Image metadata (EXIF) can reveal location, device info
- No control over how long images are retained

### How freecropimage.app Works Locally
1. FileReader API reads image into browser memory
2. Canvas API renders and processes the image
3. Blob API creates the output file
4. Download triggers save to your device
5. Zero network requests made with image data

### Use Cases for Private Cropping
- Personal and family photos
- Medical images
- Legal documents
- Confidential business materials
- Children's photos
- Any image you don't want on someone else's server

### How to Verify
Open browser DevTools (F12) → Network tab → load and crop an image → observe zero outgoing requests with image data.
